### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change restricting Flashpoint labels to non-empty `type:` tags. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Addresses #8655 by limiting Flashpoint indicator and observable labels to non-empty `type:` sighting tags, preventing sample-specific values from creating excessive labels. **Changes:** - Applies the shared type-only filter to indicators and extracted-config observables. - Updates regression tests for allowed labels while preserving actor and malware entities. - Documents the label policy; existing platform labels remain unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​flashpoint/​tests/​test_flashpoint_connector/​test_indicator_converter_to_stix.py` | Verifies type-only labels on indicators and observables. | | `external-import/​flashpoint/​src/​flashpoint_connector/​indicator_converter_to_stix.py` | Restricts labels to non-empty `type:` tags and reuses the filter. | | `external-import/​flashpoint/​README.md` | Documents which sighting tags become labels. |
Review effort: Balanced
